name: rosetta-detect-division-by-zero
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

divides(numerator: int, denominator: int) -> bool is
    try
        let _ = numerator / denominator

        return true
    catch _: System.DivideByZeroException
        return false
    yrt
si

for denominator in [2, 0] do
    write_line("10 / {denominator} divides: {divides(10, denominator)}")
od

write_line("10.0 / 0.0 is infinite: {double.is_infinity(10.0 / 0.0)}")
fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

divides(numerator: int, denominator: int) -> bool is
    try
        let _ = numerator / denominator

        return true
    catch _: System.DivideByZeroException
        return false
    yrt
si

for denominator in [2, 0] do
    write_line("10 / {denominator} divides: {divides(10, denominator)}")
od

write_line("10.0 / 0.0 is infinite: {double.is_infinity(10.0 / 0.0)}")
output:
10 / 2 divides: True
10 / 0 divides: False
10.0 / 0.0 is infinite: True
